hero.title: B2B Marketplace for Industrial & Rope Access Manpower in KSA
hero.subtitle: The smart solution for contractors to monetize idle crew capacity and rapidly mobilize certified IRATA/SPRAT technicians and specialized industrial trades.

valueProps.sectionSubtitle: A high-performance digital ecosystem built to eliminate downtime, optimize capacity, and ensure vetted safety standards.
valueProps.card1Desc: Prevent technician downtime between project phases. Sublease verified crews to vetted contractors and keep your revenue flowing.
valueProps.card2Desc: Bypass traditional recruitment delays. Deploy certified teams in Jubail, Yanbu, NEOM, and Riyadh within 48 hours.
valueProps.card3Desc: Pre-screened professionals with valid IRATA L1/L2/L3, NDT Level II certifications, and Aramco/SABIC safety compliance.

howItWorks.title: How RopeLink Works for Contractors
howItWorks.subtitle: Streamlined, frictionless workflow connecting industrial projects with verified manpower across Saudi Arabia.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Specify project scope, required technical certifications, city, and dates in under 60 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our platform algorithmically pairs requirements with certified available crews based on proximity and skills.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Finalize standardized B2B agreements and deploy crews directly to the industrial site ready to work.
